summary_1line: Satyaki, after assuring Yudhishthira’s protection and describing the formidable enemies ahead, prepares ceremonially and sets out to follow Arjuna toward Jayadratha.

image_candidates.scene_text: Satyaki stands beside his chariot with a golden lion banner while priests bless him and attendants yoke four golden-hued horses to the weapon-laden car.
Rows of armored war elephants ridden by fierce Kirata warriors loom like rain clouds on the battlefield as Satyaki prepares to charge through them.
After ritual bathing and drinking honeyed liquor, Satyaki with reddened eyes lifts his bow, shining like a blazing fire amid cheering maidens and chanting Brahmanas.
